svg.title: delta-kda
svg.desc: KDA on the toy with per-channel decay α = (0.8, 1) and β = 0.5: [2, 4] fades to [1.6, 4], the residual 3.4 is written at half strength, giving [3.3, 4]; scalar-decay Gated DeltaNet gives [3.3, 3.2]. The transition is diagonal plus a rank-1 term tied to k, which halves the chunk matrices of general DPLR. Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B: 27 layers, 20 KDA and 7 MLA, 32 heads × 128 × 128 = 524,288 state numbers per KDA layer.

text.font-family: STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif

svg.text: St = St-1 Diag(αt )(I - βt kt kt ⊤ ) + βt vt kt ⊤
Transition = diagonal + rank 1, tied to k

text.font-family: STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif

svg.text: MLA at layers 4, 8, …, 24 and 27: 20 KDA + 7 MLA
reported at 1M context: up to 75% less KV cache,
Per-channel α keeps order 2208 at 4 while 7314 is overwritten. Same state size as GDN.
Order matters: Diag(α)(I − βkkᵀ) ≠ (I − βkkᵀ)Diag(α) when k spans channels with different α.
